environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding all traffic on port 443 to the container on port 8080. The ALB has no WAF attached. The ECS task role has lambda:InvokeFunction and lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permissions. The admin Lambda function URL is configured with AuthType=NONE. The container runs as root with no seccomp profile. Security groups allow inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. No service mesh (App Mesh) is deployed - the X-Internal-Service-Auth header can be freely set by any caller.
